faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is AnySlide and how does it work?
faq.a1: AnySlide is an AI slide deck + AI image generation platform. Paste a topic, article, or link — the AI organizes the structure, matches a visual style, and generates a polished slide deck or high-quality AI images in one click.
faq.q2: What are the limits of the free plan?
faq.a2: New users get 60 credits at sign-up, with daily replenishment up to 10 credits. Generated images are stored for 7 days. The upcoming Pro plan will offer 1,000 credits per month, permanent storage, and a priority queue.
faq.q3: How does AnySlide render Chinese characters accurately?
faq.a3: AnySlide is built on gpt-image-2 and embeds Chinese characters directly into the prompt instead of describing them in English. This solves the long-standing problem of garbled or incorrect characters in AI-generated images — every Chinese character on each card is sharp and accurate.
faq.q4: How many credits does one generation cost?
faq.a4: Slides AI Image mode and AI Image mode both use gpt-image-2 at 5 credits per image. Slides HTML template mode is 1 credit per page (LLM only, very cheap). The system warns you before deducting credits — never silent.
faq.q5: How do I cancel my Pro subscription?
faq.a5: Anytime. Go to Account / Billing → Manage subscription to open the Stripe self-service portal and cancel in one click. You keep Pro benefits until the end of the current cycle, then auto-revert to Free.
faq.a6: Top-up cards (¥35 / ¥140 / ¥350): Alipay, WeChat scan, Visa / Mastercard / AmEx. Pro subscription: due to Stripe restrictions, recurring billing only supports international cards. Mainland China users are recommended to use top-up cards with manual renewal.

features.title: Why AnySlide
features.subtitle: Not a design tool — a niche-first content reframing engine. Pick a niche, paste content, get a complete image set in one click.
features.f1Desc: 8 vertical niches with preset visual style, content structure, and layout habits — results match audience taste better than generic tools.
features.f2Desc: Native gpt-image-2 CJK rendering — no garbled or misspelled characters, every word on every card crisp and accurate.
features.f3Desc: Each run outputs the image sequence + 3 viral-ready headlines + caption + recommended tags, ZIP-packaged for direct posting.
features.f4Desc: 6 built-in visual styles. AI picks the best fit for your niche and content; one tap swaps every card together.
features.f5Desc: Each card pushes to the UI as it completes — preview while generating. ~30 sec per full set on average.
features.f6Desc: Compress "saw something good" → "published a full set" into one input + one click. No second-round design or layout.
